note: Grand buildings in the corpus (Villheim-blueprints, valheimians downloads) as inspiration for each culture's hub s5. Counts and measures only (D-136). Titles and makers are credits; no corpus file is copied. Measured with the lab's blueprint parser over 668 candidate builds; the ranking uses vanilla builds only (no piece with a mod prefix).

method.pool: 668 builds matched by a title word (hall, round, temple, keep, town hall, tavern), by folder (longhouse, temple, castle, tavern, village) or by form (3 or more storeys, 500 m2 or more of floor, 11 m or higher; round plan 250 m2 or more; 350 m2 or more in 3 storeys or fewer). Statue, bridge, arena, mini-game, portal-hub, farming and artistic folders are skipped unless a title word matches. 60 or more structural pieces.
method.rankedSetRule: vanilla, a named kind, at most 75 m long, 60 m high, 15,000 structural pieces, at least 5 m high and 150 pieces, with an open ground-floor room of 120 m2 or more (cells with a floor and no floor above) or a keep or castle title
method.nearVanilla: 20 named builds have 1 to 12 mod pieces (decor such as torches, braziers, chains); they stay out of the ranking and are listed below with the prefab names
method.grandScore: mean of the percentile ranks inside the ranked set of: floor area, height, storeys (capped at 8), structural pieces, downloads
method.cultureGroups: culture sort of the research track (members.json, high and medium confidence) plus title words; a group with fewer than 5 hall-class builds gets stand-ins picked by form (see standIns in hubs.md section 'Grand buildings for s5')

featureRatesPercent.note: share of builds with the feature, top tenth by grand score against the rest of the ranked set

fields: t title, by maker, dls downloads, dir corpus folder, bb bounding box short x long m, ground floor short x long m, h height m, st storeys, pc structural pieces, room = open ground-floor room m2 @ median height m, tiers = roof tiers, hs = high seats (at an end), tw = towers (at ends, top height m), rank = place in the ranked set of 181
